predecessors.name: Yangshao culture
predecessors.text: the western Wei valley in Gansu: Qin'an County, "eastern Gansu"

successors.name: Qijia Culture
successors.text: "the core area is eastern Gansu": sites "along the upper Wei, upper Bailong, and middle and lower Tao and Daxia valleys, plus the lower Datong River", and "eastern Qinghai" (Huangshui); Lintao County…

ledger.x: 3300 BCE: the Majiayao culture appears on the Tao, Daxia and Huangshui and the upper Yellow River of Gansu and eastern Qinghai ("The culture existed from 3300 to 2000 BC").
3300 BCE: the Majiayao takes the western Wei valley of Gansu from the Yangshao ("Preceded by: Yangshao culture (5000-3000 BC)", "developed from the middle Yangshao (Miaodigou) phase").
2500 BCE: the Banshan phase begins: "Banshan (2500-2300 BC)".
2300 BCE: the Machang phase begins: "Machang (2300-2000 BC)".

certainty.note: Known from river-terrace villages and cemeteries; no frontier is recorded.
